<!-- Provide a clear description of the content -->

Disclosure: I used claude fable to assist with the pull request, especially for adding test cases, fixing edge case compilation issues, and writing docstrings. 

Transforms finite difference operators into their operator matrix equivalent through broadcast expression manipulation. Deletes `stencil_interior`, `stencil_left_boundary`, and `stencil_right_boundary` methods for operators with an operator matrix equivalent.


With the exception of  manually constructed operator matrices for `GradientF2C` and `DivergenceF2C` using the `SetValue` boundary condition, all specialized `SetValue`, `SetGradient`, `SetCurl`, and `SetDivergence` methods are deleted.

Non-extrapolate boundary conditions are now applied as a `SetBoundary` to the input or output.

Fixes the return type of gradient of a vector.

Fixes the return type of divergence of a 2-Tensor.

Modifies the boundary conditions ofadvection operators in a breaking way.
Adds to the `conv_column.jl` test. See plots [here](https://caltech.box.com/s/dq1ggh6r21lm0qxfmgfnjt5oci9y5fnm)

Modifies all non linear advection operators to use a single pathway.

Extend eager evaluation to all domains with n_levels < 256, expressions with large element types, and periodic topologies, and masked domains.


closes #2478
closes #2449
closes #2418

## Changes overview


1. **Eager FD evaluation** (`ext/cuda/operators_fd_eager.jl`): one x-thread per
   face level, one column per y-slot; each sub-expression of a broadcast is
   evaluated once per level and cached in dynamic shared memory instead of being
   re-evaluated per stencil offset. Column indices are decomposed with
   `CartesianIndices` whose `Ni`/`Nj` extents are compile-time constants read
   off the layout type (`vijh_params`), so the per-thread `divrem` uses
   fixed divisors (an earlier draft used runtime divisors and was 1.7x slower).
2. **Linear operators become matrix multiplies** inside the eager kernel: a
   `GradientF2C(θ)`-style node is rewritten to
   `FDOperatorMatrix ⋅ θ` (`MultiplyColumnwiseBandMatrixField`), with the
   operator's boundary rows folded into in-range columns
   (`MatrixFields/operator_matrices.jl`). Value-fixing BCs route through a
   generalized `SetBoundaryOperator` that gained projecting conditions
   (`SetGradient`/`SetCurl`/`SetDivergence`) so a rewritten broadcast can
   reapply the original operator's BCs.
3. **Advection operators** (upwind, FCT, TVD, LinVanLeer) become
   `AdvectionOperator`s / `NonLinearAdvectionOperator`s sharing one stencil and
   one eager shmem handler (measured 6.1x on nested FCT expressions).
4. **Boundary conditions simplified**: the one-sided advection BCs
   (`FirstOrderOneSided`, `ThirdOrderOneSided`) are replaced by a parametric
   **`Extrapolate{N}`** (N = 0, 1, 2 ghost-point extrapolation order); custom
   callable BCs are removed. Several operators/BC combinations are deleted
   outright (`AdvectionC2C/F2F`, `FluxCorrectionC2C/F2F`,
   `UpwindBiasedGradient`, `LeftBiased3rdOrder*`/`RightBiased3rdOrder*`;
   `Extrapolate` removed from `GradientF2C`/`DivergenceF2C`, `SetGradient`
   added to `GradientF2C`).


## Notable design choices and behavior changes

- **Missing BC now use finite zero boundary rows** (not main's loud NaN). This is
  deliberate and documented in NEWS, but interacts with the open BC-name
  finding below.

- **Ghost-padding advection boundaries**: all faces use the interior stencil;
  out-of-range centers are clamped then replaced by the BC's extrapolation.
  At the boundary face the extrapolation order caps at 1 (only 2 in-range
  points); order separation is only observable at the one-in face.

## Math review

- changes to the examples, and particularly the advection convergence tests in `test/Operators/finitedifference/conv_column.jl` should be looked at by someone.
- Naming of the modified `Extrapolate`
title: FD operator refactor
